headline: Concentration, not broad confirmation
summary: US indices rose on semiconductor leadership, but most S&P 500 constituents fell. Small-cap strength offers counterevidence to a broad equity sell-off.

highlights.title: Narrow breadth, resilient small caps
highlights.text: Most S&P 500 stocks declined despite the index gain, while the Russell 2000 rose 1.16%. The two signals do not support a simple all-market risk-on or capitulation conclusion.

highlights.title: AI financing merits scrutiny
highlights.text: Broadcom's Anthropic financing structure and Nvidia's Meta investment support capacity, while raising questions about supplier exposure and future cash returns. Neither proves a financing failure.

highlights.title: Macro relief, event risk
highlights.text: Lower oil and a slightly lower Treasury yield ease some pressure, but the Fed decision and major technology earnings remain within the forecast window.

forecast.horizon: 28–30 October US sessions · S&P 500 final close
forecast.method: Original forecast issued 2026-10-28T10:10:34+11:00. Subjective research probabilities, not statistically calibrated. Boundaries define final-close outcomes, not technical support or resistance.
forecast.watch_next: Watch the Fed statement, major technology earnings, breadth, credit indicators and financing disclosures. A single completed forecast is insufficient to establish calibration.

limitations: The exact VIX close, exchange advance-decline figures, consolidated volume, put/call, credit measures and DXY close were not verified. Research outlook only; not a trading signal or guarantee.
